contexts.text: The three humours, aqueous, vitreous, and crystalline, have their correspondences in the Heavens...
Diseases from the thickening, tenacity, acridness, and acidity of the humours, and thence of the blood.
Like a tree growing on a hard rock, which... withers away from lack of moisture.
On the penalties of those who have relation to the stagnant humours in the brain.
(The correspondence of the vitreous humour of the eye.)
